controls.name: (i) known: K=0 great circle at v=1/2 lies inside the outward-rounded Taylor enclosure (interval components widened by the tail bound) at 50 points
(ii) negative: a provably invalid majorant constant min(M/20, 0.9 |c_1|) is caught by the coefficient-domination check; the true M passes

common_interval.note: intersection of the per-member enclosed intervals; each member evaluated at T_common on the retained step containing it, with that step's upward-rounded error endpoint

input_representation: analytic cell: the represented input is the interval enclosure of the exact analytic vectors (sqrt and trig evaluated in interval arithmetic)
